source_notes: Hand-curated from Wikipedia 'History of Bitcoin', 'Cryptocurrency regulation', 'History of Bitcoin exchanges', Federal Reserve calendar, and widely-known market events. Impact scores are Argus's subjective estimates informed by observed post-event price action; magnitude estimates the importance/global attention of the event.

schema.date: YYYY-MM-DD (public disclosure / effective date, not any prior rumor)
schema.category: regulation | hack | adoption | macro | geopolitical | onchain | market_structure
schema.magnitude: float [0..1], 1 = market-defining event, 0.3 = notable but limited
schema.usd_impact: optional dollar magnitude (hack size, ETF inflows, etc.)
